svg.aria-label: Prompt tokens per answer for four answer paths on the same question set: full-transcript prompting 18,295; single-hop RAG 2,997, the shipped default, at 0.93 similarity to that baseline; recursive multi-hop about 10,400 for a lower composite score; the ReAct agent about 24,500, the most expensive path and not the most grounded.
svg.title: Single-hop answers at 6.1× fewer tokens; more agency costs more and buys less

g.title: full-transcript prompting · 18,295 prompt tokens · the quality baseline every other path is compared against
single-hop RAG · 2,997 prompt tokens · 0.93 answer similarity to the full-transcript baseline, 6.1 times fewer tokens — the shipped default
recursive multi-hop · about 10,400 prompt tokens · scores a lower composite than single-hop despite spending three and a half times as much
ReAct agent · about 24,500 prompt tokens · below single-hop under grounding-only RAGAS, ahead only under the depth-v2 rubric
accent marks the path that shipped: the cheapest one that keeps parity, not the most capable
